relevance_note: Japanese national survey of HA20 in which "All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3", with some numbered patients described individually in the text.
method_note: Worked by hand from a full read of the paper; a Python script only assembled the JSON, filled the 20-item checklist (not reported unless set by hand) and checked spans/fields. The paper is a national survey of 54 HA20 patients (72 estimated in Japan); patient-level data are in supplementary tables that are not in the Markdown, so rows were created only for people the main text names individually (21 numbered survey patients plus 4 relatives). The other 33 survey patients appear only in aggregate counts and have no rows; patient 15 is named only as a reference point and has no row. Applied to every numbered patient: heterozygous TNFAIP3 variant and 'pathogenic' from the all-54 statements, and 'Japanese' from 'Fifty-three ... Japanese and one was Vietnamese (patient 51)'. Inferences to check: (a) patient 3 = the single transplanted survey patient, so sex male and the skin/joint/lung/GI involvement come from the Discussion sentence 'in our patient, HCT improved symptoms ... normalized his IFN score'; (b) lymphoma onset ages 21/35/70 were mapped by the order 'patient 8, father of patient 38, grandmother of patient 15' plus 'respectively'; (c) craniopharyngioma removal was attributed to patient 8 as the only patient with craniopharyngioma; (d) 'families 1, 3 and 7' and 'patients 1, 4 and 16' carry no 'respectively', so no family label was assigned; (e) the enterectomy sentence is ambiguous on whether patient 16 had enterectomy as well as balloon dilation; (f) 'asymptomatic' for the two mosaic parents comes from 'The two patients with somatic mosaicism ... were asymptomatic'; checklist items were left not reported rather than excluded. Variant rows with variant_original_string 'not reported' were made for patient 18 (parental mosaicism statement) and the two mosaic parents (zygosity mosaic). Mosaic parents' inheritance of the proband's variant is not stated, so inheritance is not reported. 'splice' for c.2088 + 5G>C and c.2099 + 1G>A rests on 'exon 8 skipping'; p.A773fs has no author-stated class. Variants p.E192K and p.C243Y are reported in three unnamed patients and are not recorded. No group exclusions were inferred: CNS involvement (5 named) and pulmonary disease (3 named) list their patients, but 'neurological symptoms' (10) and survey ascertainment make exclusion for others unsafe. HLA types (patient 3 HLA-B51 and B27 positive) have no schema field. Contradictions: none found about a named individual; Table 2 lists acute encephalopathy (3) while the text names only patient 38 with acute encephalopathy.
